node.summary: UN General Assembly votes and international bodies.

facts.text: The UN General Assembly again adopted a resolution against the US embargo on **Cuba**; India voted as before and did not abstain.
facts.plain: The UN General Assembly again adopted a resolution against the US embargo on Cuba; India voted as before and did not abstain.

facts.text: The UNGA's annual resolution (held every year since 1992) calling on the US to end its Cuba embargo passed on 30 October with only **130 in favour, 18 abstaining and 17 against** — sharply down from 165 in favour the year before — amid US pressure on Latin American states; India again voted in favour, calling for 'dialogue and diplomacy'.

facts.text: The **Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM)** 2026 is in **Antigua and Barbuda**; **King Charles III** is head of the Commonwealth (56 members; secretariat in London).
